mentl/0a165ca:
The synth cluster's ultimate form (PLAN §1 closed-over-proposers): a
candidate is a fragment minted into the live graph, run through the SAME
infer walk that types all source, gated by NBound, rolled back — only
kernel-proven inhabitants reach the cursor. Four Carried-Truth fixes,
all toward LESS code:

1. Dissolve the EnvLookup effect (synth_proposer.mn) — a second
   env-access effect with no handler that re-derived what EnvRead's
   env_snapshot already proves. enumerate_constructors now reads the
   live env snapshot and filters bindings for ConstructorScheme whose
   result type is TName(type_name, _); its row follows the new op-call
   sites (EnvRead, not the unhandled EnvLookup).

2. Wire verify_candidate to the real gate. Candidate nodes were minted
   with handle 0 (a fixed meaningless node the gate chased for every
   candidate, never inferring). synth_node/synth_hole_node now mint via
   mint_node (the AST-in-graph fabric) for real handles; verify_candidate
   runs infer_expr over the candidate then reads its handle live via
   verify_after_apply — checkpoint -> infer -> verify -> rollback.

3. Wire cursor.mn mentl_context_at to read (scope, effects) live from
   env_snapshot + the node's bound row (row_of_kind already computed) —
   the Context([],[]) stub is dissolved.

4. Dissolve the static string-keyed handler-catalog table
   (catalog_handled_effects) — a handler binds as HandlerKind(E, ...),
   so the env already proves which effect each handler absorbs; read it
   live via env_lookup, the same E the ~> row algebra reads.

Gate: seed builds, ev2/4/8=57 ev5=21 ev16=18, drift-audit clean.
Census is the informational shadow (the seed lags the wheel).
mentl/0a2f36d:
A 350-line Python harness that satisfies cursor.mn's substrate
contracts in a host language so the eight-aspect projection can be
SEEN — not waiting for L1 closure to bring the canonical wheel up.

Each function mirrors a wheel primitive:

  cursor_at         ←→ src/cursor.mn:100-120 (eight-aspect projection)
  cursor_argmax     ←→ src/cursor.mn:227-275 (gates × proximity)
  cursor_loop       ←→ src/cursor_transport.mn:292-318 (bus-compressor)
  proximity weights ←→ src/cursor.mn:312-316 (1.0/0.85/0.7/0.4/0.2)

The Reason ADT is the same Reason. The Cursor record is the same
Cursor. The eight aspects are the same eight (Query/Propose/Topology/
Row/Trace/Verify/Teach/Why). This is the medium expressed in a host
substrate that already runs.

Run:  python3 tools/editor/mentl-edit-tier0/mentl-edit.py

ENTER advances the cursor along the gradient. ?? <handle> pins.
q quits. The session opens at the gradient's argmax over a small
hand-built graph (fn add / fn double / fn main). Each step renders
the eight-aspect view and waits for the developer's next action.

Tier 0 dissolves when bootstrap/mentl.wasm runs cursor.mn natively
post-L1. The canonical implementation IS cursor.mn; this file is
scaffolding that recognizes its own dissolution.

The medium had been untouchable. Now it isn't.

noodles/0aee228:
Three landings that finish the built-out bank. The chop deck ships
in P4's ratified shape: melody gains a source toggle beside the
synth, a loaded sample is normalized once (RMS to -16 dBFS under a
-1 dB cap) and sliced at transient hits or on a 16-grid, the piano
roll's rows become slices (upper rows replay the set at double
rate - D6's repitch paid by row height), playback runs raw context
nodes with a 4 ms declick tail into the melody color junction, and
key travel leaves slice rows untransposed. Session-scoped like the
user drum one-shots; one persistence fork now covers both.

Harmony entries grow a fourth tone: the bloom's 7/9/sus4/sus2 land
in the playing clip when armed (release on a pad is as deliberate
as a tap), voiced above the led triad in playback exactly as in
audition. harmonyChord names them - V7, Cmaj7, Bo7 half-diminished,
sus without a third - and a diatonic triad under the extension
keeps its degree's roman and function color; only true visitors
wear the violet. The staff engraves extensions on interval-honest
letters. The piano roll's Arp transform stops indexing CHORDS with
an entry it can no longer index (the one D13 consumer the sweep
missed).

And the HUMAN slider: up to 8 ms of per-hit drift inside the same
swing offset both the live clock and the offline render read, so
the take breathes the same way everywhere. The smoke gate builds
a WAV in-page, slices it both ways, flips the source, reads slice
rows, and rides the slider.
noodles/0ac3923:
Audit of everything this session touched, worst finding first.

The arrangement playhead still rode a CSS transition — the exact
second-clock flaw just removed from the pie timers: per-16th transform
pushes interpolated on the browser's animation timeline, stalling and
re-sweeping under jank. The clock loop now ships an anchor (context time
of bar 0, bar seconds, the live loop region) and the same per-frame pump
that drives the pies derives the playhead from audio.heardNow — with the
loop wrap computed in the pump, so the visual wraps exactly when the
audio does. Measured: continuous per-frame motion, wraps 3.997->2.001 at
the loop boundary, 4000ms per 2-bar cycle on the nose, no overshoot.
Scene and arrangement anchors clear each other, so neither mode ever
drives the other's stale visuals.

Pinches could fight the one-finger handlers. A pinch starting over a
clip kept feeding that clip's captured pointer (drag applied while
zooming), same for the loop brace, and edge auto-pan could keep
scrolling under the transform; a canceled pinch — e.g. the touchcancel a
native-scroll takeover fires — later COMMITTED its stale scale,
teleporting the view. Now: drag handlers and auto-pan yield while
arrPinching; touchend commits but touchcancel reverts; an orphaned pinch
(new touch, pair gone) reverts; a two-finger tap that never spread skips
the rebuild instead of re-rendering at scale 1.

Export offers died with the sheet: results rendered into a sheet-local
div, so closing during a render silently lost the finished WAV, and blob
URLs were never revoked. Offers now live at module level, re-render on
every sheet open, and old URLs are revoked before a new export.

Docs caught up: AGENTS.md export line (loop render + tap-to-save),
ROADMAP perf line (pinch commits one rebuild on release, not coalesced
per-frame rebuilds).

Gates, all green: calibrate master spread 1.0 dB (combos -5.6..-6.6,
peaks -0.2), dice spread 1.8 dB; smoke passes incl. WAV content
assertion; pies wrap 2000
celezdial/0a2731e:

the engine, chart math, and sign data — the file shrinks by ~200 lines
while gaining every feature below.

sextiles lift the involved voices' velocities, conjunctions focus them,

tension through the Chebyshev.

88s), phases spread on the golden ratio. Each chart header gets a "now"

new machinery. Chain pills in the veil rewire the FX graph live.

birth inputs), gains Load, and Link packs the state into the URL
fragment — birth data never leaves the browser. Restores are silent by
